TESTS, WRITE THEM FIRST in tests/test_factory_stations.py (extend that file; follow its fake `Runner` style; read the existing free_gates tests first): (1) default payload runs the journey command after the carry matrix gate (use the existing monkeypatched carry matrix to order them) and before ruff, with the exact argument list above, cwd the repository root, timeout 240, and PYTHONPATH containing the root and packages/worldkeeper/src; (2) `journey_reachability: false` skips it entirely (the runner sees no pytest call for it); (3) a non-zero exit returns check `journey_reachability` with the prefix and the output tail, and ruff and the listed tests never run after it; (4) a timeout returns check `journey_reachability` and 'command timed out'; (5) with a ticket tree the command runs in the tree, not the original root; (6) a failure in the carry matrix gate stops before the journey gate. tasks.check:
set -eo pipefail
WORK=/home/bcorfman/dev/ringer-work/factory-32
mkdir -p "$WORK/out"
export PYTHONPATH=$PWD:$PWD/packages/worldkeeper/src TMPDIR=/tmp
[ -e .venv ] || ln -s /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv .venv
git reset -q
git add -A -- factory tests
bad=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=d | grep -vE '^(factory/stations/free_gates\.py|tests/test_factory_stations\.py)$' || true)
[ -z "$bad" ] || { echo "files outside ownership staged: $bad"; exit 1; }
start=$(date +%s)
out=$(.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider -rs -n 4 tests/test_factory_stations.py tests/test_factory_checks.py 2>&1) || { echo "$out"; exit 1; }
echo "$out" | tail -6
took=$(( $(date +%s) - start ))
echo "tests took $took s (budget 120 s)"
[ "$took" -le 120 ] || { echo "over the 120 s budget"; exit 1; }
case "$out" in *skipped*) echo "tests were skipped"; exit 1;; esac
grep -q 'journey_reachability' factory/stations/free_gates.py || { echo "gate missing from free_gates.py"; exit 1; }
grep -q 'run-nightly' factory/stations/free_gates.py || { echo "--run-nightly missing"; exit 1; }
grep -nE "k_sl_|k_scene_|SL-[0-9]|\b[123][A-C]\b" factory/stations/free_gates.py && { echo "story-specific names in production code"; exit 1; } || true
PYFILES=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=d | grep '\.py$' || true)
[ -z "$PYFILES" ] || .venv/bin/python -m ruff check $PYFILES
[ -z "$PYFILES" ] || .venv/bin/python -m ruff format --check $PYFILES
git diff --cached > "$WORK/out/wire-reachability.patch"
test -s "$WORK/out/wire-reachability.patch"
